title: Long-Running Resumable Autonomous System
description: Build an autonomous agent designed for multi-hour tasks: durable task queue with checkpoints, failure recovery with exponential backoff, budget enforcement (time/cost/steps), and an honest end-of-run report that never hides failures behind retries.
learningObjectives: Design checkpointed long-running execution with crash recovery
Enforce budgets deterministically (steps, tokens, wall clock)
Implement retry with backoff that preserves failure history
Produce auditable end-of-run reports including aborted work

milestones.title: Durable task queue
milestones.objective: Persist a task graph; a mid-run kill resumes with completed tasks untouched.
milestones.expectedOutput: Crash-recovery test passes at three crash points.

milestones.title: Budget enforcement
milestones.objective: Enforce wall-clock, step-count, and cost budgets; overruns abort cleanly with partial results.
milestones.expectedOutput: Budget table showing limits and actual usage per run.

milestones.title: Failure recovery
milestones.objective: Retries with exponential backoff; repeated failures marked failed with reason, never silently dropped.
milestones.expectedOutput: Injected-failure test showing backoff + failure surfacing.

milestones.title: Auditable report
milestones.objective: Generate an end-of-run report: tasks done/failed/aborted, tokens, cost, wall time, and trace links.
milestones.expectedOutput: Report artifact for at least one full run.

categories.minimumExpectation: Kill-and-resume tests pass at multiple crash points

categories.excellentExpectation: Reviewer can re-derive the report from raw traces

architecture: task graph store → scheduler → workers with checkpoints → reporter
constraints: Failures must appear in reports even after successful retries
hints: Pick a genuinely long task (e.g. evolving code benchmarks for hours) but prove the machinery with 10-minute scaled-down runs
